title: The Maternity Ward and the Car Theft

scenes.title: At the Maternity Hospital Reception
scenes.summary: Max arrives at the maternity hospital looking for Vika and asks the receptionist how he can get inside to see his wife.

scenes.title: The Other Goncharova
scenes.summary: Max confuses another patient named Masha Goncharova with Vika and learns on the phone that Vika is back at work.

scenes.title: After a Wild Night
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tries to calm down a drunk Mikhail Dzhekovich, who wants to find Nagiyev's address and settle the score over Eleonora.

scenes.title: False Contractions and an Important Guest
scenes.summary: Max interrupts Vika's meeting with VIP guest Nikolai Maryanovich, and right after their argument Vika's water breaks for real.

scenes.title: The Car Thief Story
scenes.summary: Nikita tells Katya a tall tale about stealing luxury cars as a side job, while Eleonora asks Chef Barinov if he has seen Mikhail.

scenes.title: The Faulty Oven and the Office Couch
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tells Eleonora the kitchen oven is broken and convinces a furious Mikhail to lie down on his office sofa.

scenes.title: Guarding the Office and Traffic Jams
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov locks Mikhail in his office to keep him out of trouble and puts Senya on guard duty outside the door.

scenes.title: An Order for Nagiyev's Jeep
scenes.summary: Katya challenges Nikita to steal Nagiyev's SUV for a kiss, and Nikita begins plotting how to take Nagiyev's keys.

scenes.title: Three Failed Options
scenes.summary: Nikita fails to swipe Nagiyev's car keys at the table and has to admit to Katya that his plan did not work.

scenes.title: Keys from Mom and Senya's Prisoner
scenes.summary: Eleonora gives Nikita the keys to Nagiyev's car to help him impress Katya, while Senya refuses to let Mikhail out of the office.

scenes.title: Restroom Escape and Keys in Hand
scenes.summary: Senya lets Mikhail go to the restroom, while Nikita shows Katya the stolen car keys and claims his promised kiss.

scenes.title: All Delivery Rooms Are Full
scenes.summary: Max and Vika arrive at the crowded maternity ward where all delivery rooms are occupied, and Max refuses to leave Vika in the corridor.

scenes.title: A Performance for Captain Smirnov
scenes.summary: Pulled over by traffic police without car documents, Nikita pretends Katya is his careless wife and convinces the officer to let them go.

scenes.title: The Room for the Minister's Wife
scenes.summary: Max bluffs the hospital staff into believing Vika is the minister's wife so she can move into the empty luxury maternity suite.

scenes.title: The Promised Kiss and the Bumper Crash
scenes.summary: Mikhail wakes up groggy asking if he fought Nagiyev, while Nikita and Katya kiss in the jeep and accidentally bump Eleonora's car.

scenes.title: Victor Takes the Blame
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov covers for Katya and Nikita by telling Eleonora that he accidentally backed Nagiyev's car into hers.

scenes.title: Jealousy or Pity
scenes.summary: Eleonora accuses Chef Barinov of being jealous of her romance with Nagiyev, while Victor recommends Mikhail Dzhekovich instead.

scenes.title: The Real Minister in the Ward
scenes.summary: Nikolai Maryanovich arrives at the maternity ward and orders Max and Vika out of the VIP suite, but Max refuses to budge.

scenes.title: Defending the Ward with a Fire Extinguisher
scenes.summary: Max defends Vika's room with a fire extinguisher until Nikolai Maryanovich learns his own wife went to a different maternity hospital.

scenes.title: The Birth of Their Daughter
scenes.summary: Max stays by Vika's side during the delivery, and together they welcome their newborn daughter into the world.
